title: Manual Cleave Elution
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol UI, input the desired number of rows and columns to be filled for each plate.

steps.title: Download and unzip files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware JSON
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload your custom labware files with .json extensions.

steps.title: Upload protocol Python file
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck for up to 4 plates
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map, placing a single reagent reservoir and arranging up to four 96‑well plates as required.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App calibration tools (refer to support articles for details).

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the protocol.
